title: review-loop accept (one line of accepts.jsonl)
description: Written only by `review-loop accept` after an interactive TTY confirmation. Stored at $(git rev-parse --git-common-dir)/review-loop/accepts.jsonl. Keyed by (finding_id, rule_class), never by patch-id; re-evaluated live by `gate`. A review accept (rule_class=review) never clears a deterministic or needs_human finding.

expires.description: Required for every security class; null only for review accepts.

patch_id.description: Informational only; the accept is not scoped to it.
